items.statement: Real, complete geometry calculations establish which primary model agrees better with SCXRD on the measured quantities, or establish a supported mixed/tied comparison.
items.expected: Award scientific credit for the actual geometry comparison supported by validated calculations, complete requested observables and correct metrics. Uniform, mixed and indistinguishable outcomes can all fully satisfy this conclusion; do not replace missing calculations with a narrative assertion. Preserve the author method pair; a supported mixed/tied outcome completes the comparison but is NOT a reproduction of the authors' CAM-wins hypothesis. A CAM preference, where found, applies to the calculated conformers. Do not demand exact SI theoretical columns or hidden private witness values. Give partial credit for supported portions when work is incomplete; missing a generic limitation paragraph is not a deduction. This is the only primary scientific conclusion, not four equally weighted outcome labels.
